moves.change: Keep daily updates running across an earlier trading halt
moves.reason: Lawful change: a listing whose new sessions all follow its last session, with every prior session and value retained, is disclosed by the writer as a tail append and accepted by reconciliation instead of refused; every other session-set change is refused as before
